title: LP1-05: candidate word sums and rune segmentation
question: Do the sixteen supplied Latin word candidates admit the claimed GP sums, and are those sums forced by their spellings?
summary: Sixteen fixed candidates admit their proposed totals; THAN has two rune-label segmentations and AETHEREAL eight. All 24 segmentations are retained.

scope.representation: Sixteen supplied Latin words, uppercase with V replaced by U; exact GP Latin-label segmentations.
scope.procedure: Enumerate all segmentations, sum prime values, and compare each with its supplied target.
scope.parameters: Fixed 16 candidates; 24 complete segmentations; no dictionary expansion.
scope.exclusions: Other words, synonyms, alternate spellings, altered rune values, key searches, manuscript decryption and statistical significance.

finding: All sixteen supplied totals are achievable. THAN also admits 208; AETHEREAL admits eight totals, only one equal to 366. Matching sums do not recover a unique word or demonstrate a cipher.
limitations: Selected candidate list; no unbiased match-rate estimate, dictionary search or manuscript decryption. Computational review; human review pending.
next_steps: Group alternate vocabulary or transliteration rules as explicit variants. Define a separate bounded transform before using candidates as cipher keys.
